newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran police kill smugglers, seize drugs.
newsitem.headline: Iran police kill smugglers, seize drugs.

text.p: Police killed four armed smugglers and seized more than a tonne of drugs in a clashes in northeastern Iran, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Thursday.

It said police seized 997 kg (2,193 lb) of morphine and 74 kg (166 lb) of opium after killing the traffickers in three separate clashes over the past two days in Khorasan province, which borders Afghanistan.
Police also arrested three smugglers and captured machine guns, rocket-propelled grenades and assault rifles, the agency said.
Iranian officials said on Wednesday they had seized 150 tonnes of drugs in eastern Iran in the past 11 months, a 20 percent increase over the corresponding period a year ago.
Iran is a key transit route for drugs, mostly opium from which heroin is made, reaching Europe via Turkey from Afghanistan and Pakistan.
